subject: 辽金北方·酒楼／茶肆（原创扩展；历史细部待考）
prompt: Create a NEW northern Liao-Jin version of the reference Song game map building, retaining its camera, complete very thin diamond footprint, true clean transparency, entrance direction and detailed realistic ancient architectural rendering. This is a CITY MAP SPRITE, not a perspective architectural showcase. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, 2:1 dimetric projection, ground axes +0.5 and -0.5, upright verticals, parallel lines, no perspective. Entrance screen LOWER LEFT. Both ground axes clearly readable; complete flat rectangular ground perimeter with LEFT, FRONT and RIGHT corners. Entire sprite occupies central 70 percent of canvas. Main light screen UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow lower right. Background alpha=0, NO glow, halo or gradient. No thick plinth, text, people, sky, landscape, neighboring structures, symbols, Ming/Qing palace ornaments or modern features. One self-contained building. Historic regional inspiration, original game interpretation rather than monument reconstruction. Subject: one Liao-Jin northern town wine-house and tea-shop building, footprint12m east-west by9m north-south, original unnamed game establishment in Yanjing/Datong region. Two-story broad timber commercial hall with one restrained gray tiled gabled roof, deep eaves, buff earthen plaster infill and dark wood posts, simple upstairs balcony and rectangular lattice windows. Ground-floor lower-left open veranda has three plain wood tables, benches, ceramic tea bowls and squat wine jars, NO people, no signage or characters. Narrow side service room under lower gray tile roof; thin bare-earth and stone paving strip exactly contained within footprint. Northern weathered materials, no palace ornaments, no red lanterns, no plants. Ground front edge4/3 of side, visible ground edge angles26.565 degrees =0.5 slope, flatter than classic isometric30degrees.
negative: 文字、人物、水印、现代物、背景街景、厚地台、宫廷彩画、裁切、透视汇聚

references.role: 宋套件实际PNG：材质、细节密度、相机与拼接形态参考

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize with integer rounding
processing.excluded_operations: no repaint, alpha thresholding, warping, flip, anisotropic correction or synthetic corners

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读取可见底面三点，±10源像素；非3D测绘。隐藏后角未实测；等比规格化不修正相机误差。

notes: 两层酒楼、左下廊前桌凳与酒坛，去掉宋参考红色布幔，以朴素灰瓦土灰墙表达北方；同一写实古风密度。薄铺地轮廓清楚，无文字人物。 已生成2候选对比，选第1候选，原因见rejected_candidate。 仅交单视图；历史游戏功能为原创扩展，屋架、窗棂等细部待考。
